'''The Crystal Passage''', also known as the '''Kiirium Crawl''', was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] in [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] that originated at [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], at its intersection with the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] and the [[Old Corellian Run]], and headed southeast toward the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]].<ref name="TEA" />
